title: Microsoft Purview: preserve shared cloud attachment versions for users on hold
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned hold-based preservation capability from the documented retention-label alternative. The roadmap facts and existing controls are supported; minor corrections concern a wizard heading and checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to preserve shared cloud attachment file versions for users put on infinite hold.
claims.quote: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; front matter: confidence
claims.claim: Learn describes the neighbouring capabilities but not this new hold-based preservation capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachments infinite hold users preservation 493752 licensing default admin PowerShell; opened edisc-cloud-attachments, edisc-hold-create, apply-retention-labels-automatically and the Purview service description. Results describe holds or label-based preservation.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what the new capability does on arrival without admin action.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention; read roadmap, edisc-cloud-attachments, edisc-hold-create and auto-apply label documentation. None gives an arrival default for the new hold-based capability.

claims.claim: No admin setting or automation is documented for preserving cloud attachment versions for users on infinite hold.
claims.quote: Searched: cloud attachments infinite hold PowerShell preservation enable; Purview cloud attachments infinite hold users preservation 493752 licensing default admin PowerShell. Read New-RetentionCompliancePolicy and the hold and cloud attachment pages; only the separate label-based option is documented.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence covering the new hold-based cloud attachment capability is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachments users on hold license price retention preservation; read Purview service description licensing sections and edisc-hold-create. Those cover retention labels and eDiscovery holds, not the unidentified hold-based capability in this record.

claims.claim: No meter for this new capability is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: cloud attachments users hold preservation licensing default permissions storage price; Purview cloud attachments users on hold license price retention preservation. Read Purview service description; storage-pricing results concern SharePoint, OneDrive or Archive, not this capability.

claims.claim: A storage charge for versions preserved by the new capability is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: cloud attachments users hold preservation licensing default permissions storage price; read cloud attachment and Purview licensing pages and storage-pricing excerpts. They do not identify where this new capability stores its versions or how that storage is charged.

claims.claim: No price for this capability is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachments users on hold license price retention preservation; cloud attachments users hold preservation licensing default permissions storage price. Read Purview service description and returned pricing excerpts; no price is tied to this new capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described access to the new capability's preserved versions.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention; read cloud attachment and hold pages and Purview permissions excerpt. No result describes access to the new capability's preserved versions.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not identified the account or service that performs this preservation.
claims.quote: Searched: cloud attachments users hold preservation licensing default permissions storage price; Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention. Read edisc-cloud-attachments and edisc-hold-create; no executing identity is described for it.

claims.claim: The new capability's permissions and configuring roles have not been stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention. Read hold and label prerequisites and Purview permissions excerpt; those identify roles for existing solutions, not which hold mechanism this capability uses.

claims.claim: Learn does not describe rollout mechanics for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention. Read edisc-cloud-attachments, edisc-hold-create and apply-retention-labels-automatically; no rollout mechanics for hold-based preservation are stated.

claims.claim: Learn does not describe prerequisites for this new capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention. Read the hold and auto-apply label prerequisites; no prerequisites identify this separate capability or settle which hold type it requires.

claims.claim: Whether the new capability shares the retention-label option's limitations is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachment preservation hold default rollout prerequisites roles permissions storage retention; read edisc-cloud-attachments and apply-retention-labels-automatically. Their limitations describe collection or label-based retention, not the new hold-based preservation.

claims.claim: A cloud attachment is a link to a SharePoint or OneDrive file rather than an embedded copy.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments are links to files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive rather than embedded copies.

claims.claim: By default, eDiscovery cloud attachment collection includes only the current file version.
claims.quote: By default, the eDiscovery workflow for collecting cloud attachments only includes adding the most current version of a cloud attachment to a review set or for export.

claims.claim: The current version collected may differ from the version originally shared.
claims.quote: the version you collect and add to a review set or export might be different from the version that was originally shared in the cloud attachment.

claims.claim: Content present when a cloud attachment was shared might no longer exist in its current version.
claims.quote: content that was present in the cloud attachment at the time it was shared might be removed and doesn't exist in the current version that's added to the review set or exported.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment retention-label option creates a file copy at sharing time and applies the selected label to that copy.
claims.quote: When you choose the option to apply a retention label to cloud attachments, for compliance purposes, a copy of that file is created at the time of sharing. Your selected retention label is then applied to the copy

claims.claim: The label-based copy is stored in the Preservation Hold library.
claims.quote: Users aren't aware of the copy that is stored in the Preservation Hold library.

claims.claim: Learn calls an eDiscovery hold of all content in specified locations an infinite hold.
claims.quote: Create an infinite hold where all content in the specified locations is placed on hold.

claims.claim: eDiscovery treats cloud attachments as part of their parent message.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments are treated as part of the parent's message, not separate entities.

claims.claim: A search matching a parent message retrieves its linked cloud attachment even when the file does not meet the search condition.
claims.quote: If an email or Teams message matches the condition of a search, its linked cloud attachments are retrieved - even if the file doesn't meet the condition of the search.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment retention-label option does not support encrypted emails or encrypted messages.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments and links in encrypted emails or encrypted messages aren't supported.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: eDiscovery holds require an eligible licence on every user whose content is preserved.
claims.quote: eDiscovery holds require an eligible license on every user whose content you preserve.

claims.claim: Office 365 F1 and F3 subscriptions do not include rights to be the target of an eDiscovery hold.
claims.quote: Frontline subscriptions such as Office 365 F1 and F3 don't include the rights required to be the target of an eDiscovery hold.

claims.claim: The Purview service description documents retention-label and retention-label-policy licensing under Data Lifecycle & Records Management.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle & Records Management; Licensing for retention labels; Licensing for retention label policies

claims.claim: The retention-label alternative is reached through Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label > Apply label to cloud attachments and links shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage, and Copilot.
claims.quote: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label. For Choose the type of content you want to apply this label to, select one of the available conditions.
claims.fix: Add the wizard-page heading: 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label > Choose the type of content you want to apply this label to > Apply label to cloud attachments and links shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage, and Copilot'. The cited auto-apply page gives the route and heading; the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-m365-copilot gives the final option label.

claims.claim: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy name>" -SharePointLocation <site URL> -RetainCloudAttachment $true creates a cloud attachment auto-apply label policy.
claims.quote: The RetainCloudAttachment parameter specifies that this is a cloud attachment policy. Valid values are: $true: The policy is a cloud attachment policy. The SharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to include. You identify the site by its URL value

claims.claim: The New-RetentionCompliancePolicy example creates the policy, and New-RetentionComplianceRule adds a retention label to it.
claims.quote: This example creates a new auto-apply label policy targeted to cloud attachments named Marketing Department with the specified details. The next step is to use the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to add a retention label to the retention label policy.

claims.claim: RetainCloudAttachment is currently in Preview.
claims.quote: This parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.

claims.claim: RetainCloudAttachment is not available in all organisations.
claims.quote: This parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.

claims.claim: The RetainCloudAttachment parameter is subject to change.
claims.quote: This parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.

claims.claim: The cloud attachment retention label is not applied to the original file.
claims.quote: The retention label isn't applied to the message itself, or to the original file.

claims.claim: The cloud attachment retention label is not applied to the message itself.
claims.quote: The retention label isn't applied to the message itself, or to the original file.

claims.claim: A label used for cloud attachments should use the When items were labeled retention-start setting.
claims.quote: ensure that the label retention setting Start the retention period based on is When items were labeled.

claims.claim: The existing hold inventory is reached through Microsoft Purview portal > eDiscovery > Cases > case > Hold policies.
claims.quote: Select the eDiscovery solution card and then select Cases in the left navigation. Select a case, and then select the Hold policies tab.

claims.claim: The checklist names Access links (cloud attachments) in messages as a collection control, but the controls table has no row for it.
claims.quote: check which versions eDiscovery collects with the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option selected; table rows: Whether cloud attachment versions are preserved for users on infinite hold; Existing alternative: retention label policy
claims.fix: The 'Test with a pilot custodian' checklist step names a collection control with no table row. Remove 'with the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option selected' from that step; the option itself is supported by https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-cloud-attachments.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to inventory existing eDiscovery holds, but those holds have no controls-table row.
claims.quote: Inventory which users are on eDiscovery holds today and note which are infinite holds; table rows cover the undocumented new capability and the existing retention-label alternative, not existing eDiscovery holds.
claims.fix: The 'Inventory which users are on eDiscovery holds today' checklist step reviews an existing control with no table row. Remove that checklist bullet rather than adding an unverified row.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to review the audit log, but the controls table has no audit row.
claims.quote: Review the audit log and Preservation Hold library storage for the sites involved; the controls table contains only the new capability's gap and the retention-label alternative.
claims.fix: The 'Review the audit log' checklist step names monitoring with no table row. Replace the bullet with 'Confirm what reporting Microsoft documents for the capability before deciding how to monitor preserved versions and storage.'

claims.claim: Selecting Access links (cloud attachments) in messages enables inclusion of linked content in eDiscovery collection workflows.
claims.quote: To enable the collection of cloud attachments, select the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option so linked content is included in Add to review set and export workflows.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment label policy can cover SharePoint sites, Microsoft 365 Groups and OneDrive accounts.
claims.quote: When you configure the locations for this option, you can select: SharePoint classic and communication sites; Microsoft 365 Groups; OneDrive accounts

claims.claim: Whether the eDiscovery hold licence requirement covers the new capability's unspecified hold mechanism remains unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview cloud attachments users on hold license price retention preservation; read edisc-hold-create and Purview service description. They cover eDiscovery holds, but neither identifies this new capability's infinite hold as an eDiscovery hold.
